product.name: Aurelio Apex Tripod
product.description: The Aurelio Apex Tripod delivers reliable stability for photographers of all skill levels. Constructed from lightweight aluminum alloy, the tripod extends to 100 cm and folds to 30 cm for easy transport. Each leg is fitted with rubber feet to secure surfaces, and the center column features a quick‑release plate compatible with DSLR, mirrorless, and smartphone cameras. The adjustable head offers 360° pan and 90° tilt, while the built‑in locking lever ensures precise positioning. Designed for both studio and on‑location use, the Apex Tripod balances durability with portability, making it an ideal companion for travel shoots, event coverage, and everyday photography.
